# ping.exe is all Rust (ping-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ping-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# ping.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ping-rust/src/ping/ping.rs)
add_cargo_module(ping ping-cargo ping.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE ping-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS xdk psdk)
